authority: Searchright owns systematic search and provenance-rich CSL-JSON corpus. Sourceright reconciles references; CiteWeft extracts; ASReview screens; pybibx/bibliometrix/VOSviewer/tobac/voiage analyse.
review_policy: Do not archive until all applicable assertions, tests, exact-head checks, live/provider/consumer evidence and independent review pass. Original history remains in Git.
